newsitem.title: USA: Echlin names Joseph Onorato CFO.
newsitem.headline: Echlin names Joseph Onorato CFO.

text.p: Echlin Inc said Friday Joseph Onorato had been elected vice president and chief financial officer, a newly created position.
The company also said Robert "Bob" Daley had been appointed vice president of sales and marketing for its North American Aftermarket Operations, also a new position.
Onorato has been Echlin's treasurer since 1990 and vice president-treasurer since 1994.
Daley's new responsibilities include Echlin's automotive brake, engine systems, small engine, marine and import parts divisions in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
Daley has served as president of Echlin's Engine Systems Group since 1993.
